tools.name: HostIP
tools.description: French web service to geolocate an IP address: country, region, city, coordinates and ISP, displayed on a map.

tools.name: AbuseIPDB
tools.description: Community-driven database of malicious IP addresses: abuse reports filed by security professionals, confidence-of-abuse score, reported categories (brute force, scanning, spam…), ISP and usage type.

tools.name: Scamalytics
tools.description: IP fraud-risk scoring service and AbuseIPDB alternative: fraud score, proxy / VPN / Tor detection, blacklist status and operator details for an IP address.

tools.name: Cyberbro
tools.description: Open-source analysis hub that checks an observable (IP, domain, URL, hash…) against multiple engines at once — reputation, reverse DNS, whois, web search — and aggregates the results. The link points to the project's public demo instance.

tools.name: suip.biz
tools.description: Free online recon toolbox running many security tools from a single website: nmap port scanning, whois, DNS records, reverse IP, subdomain enumeration, HTTP header and CMS detection, and more.

tools.name: ipapi.is
tools.description: IP intelligence lookup and API: precise geolocation, ASN, company and hosting details, plus VPN / proxy / datacenter detection and abuse contact for the queried IP.

tools.name: IPinfo
tools.description: IP data platform offering geolocation, ASN, company, carrier and privacy detection (VPN, proxy, Tor) through a clean web interface and API, with a free tier.

tools.name: UnshortLink
tools.description: Expands shortened links (bit.ly, tinyurl, t.co…) to reveal the real destination URL before you click, helping spot redirects to suspicious domains.

tools.name: URLVoid
tools.description: Website reputation scanner: checks a domain or URL against dozens of blocklists and reputation engines, and reports traffic, location, registrar and hosting details.

tools.name: Sucuri SiteCheck
tools.description: Free remote website security scanner: checks a site for malware, injected spam and defacements, blacklist status, and outdated or vulnerable software.

tools.name: Control D Website Link Checker
tools.description: Website link checker by Control D: tests whether a URL or domain is safe to open, flagging malware, phishing and other malicious categories before you visit it.

tools.name: IsItPhishing
tools.description: AI-powered phishing detection: submit a URL to get a verdict on whether it is a phishing attempt, complementing blocklist-based checkers with machine-learning analysis.

tools.name: crt.sh
tools.description: Certificate transparency search engine: enumerates subdomains and hostnames of a domain from issued TLS/SSL certificates, a classic passive recon source.

tools.name: DNSDumpster
tools.description: Complete DNS cartography of a domain: subdomains, DNS records, mail and name servers, with a visual graph of the external footprint.

tools.name: DNSlytics
tools.description: DNS history and reverse IP lookup: past DNS records, hosting provider, domains co-hosted on the same IP, and ASN / domain analytics.

tools.name: MXToolbox
tools.description: Email and DNS toolbox: MX, SPF, DMARC and DKIM lookups, blacklist checks on IPs and domains, SMTP diagnostics and header analysis.

tools.name: ViewDNS.info
tools.description: DNS and domain research toolbox: WHOIS, historical IP and DNS records, reverse IP lookup, port scan and many other lookups from one site.

tools.name: CyberChef
tools.description: GCHQ's "Swiss Army knife" of data analysis and a must-have for any investigation: decode Base64, URL-encode/decode, deobfuscate JavaScript, extract strings, parse timestamps and chain hundreds of operations into recipes.

tools.name: VirusTotal
tools.description: The absolute reference for the reputation of files, IPs, domains and URLs: a hash or sample is checked against dozens of antivirus engines, with behavioral and community context.

tools.name: MalwareBazaar
tools.description: abuse.ch's open malware sample database: look up recent samples and their signatures by MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 hash, tag, family or actor.

tools.name: Hybrid Analysis
tools.description: Free and powerful online sandbox: submit a suspicious file and get a behavioral analysis report with IOCs, network activity and a malware verdict.

tools.name: ANY.RUN
tools.description: Interactive real-time malware sandbox: run a sample or URL in a live VM and watch its processes and network actions as they happen; the free tier is limited but very useful.

tools.name: URL Unshortener
tools.description: Expands shortened URLs (bit.ly, t.co, tinyurl…) to reveal the real destination without clicking the link; getlinkinfo.com is a well-known alternative.

tools.name: urlscan.io
tools.description: Scans a URL safely and returns a screenshot, the DOM, network requests and the IOCs of the page — indispensable for phishing analysis.

tools.name: PhishTank
tools.description: Collaborative database specialized in phishing: check whether a URL is a known phishing page and contribute verdicts, with data available for integration.

tools.name: AlienVault OTX
tools.description: Open Threat Exchange, one of the largest IoC-sharing communities: check whether an indicator is known in recent threat pulses and follow adversary groups.

tools.name: ThreatFox
tools.description: abuse.ch platform dedicated to IOCs associated with malware: search and share C2 servers, distribution URLs and their malware families.

tools.name: Intelligence X
tools.description: Powerful search engine over data leaks, pastes, the dark web, historical WHOIS and DNS records, with pivots on emails, domains, IPs and phone numbers.

tools.name: Microsoft Message Header Analyzer
tools.description: Paste the raw headers of an email to make them readable: hop-by-hop route, delays between servers and SPF / DKIM / DMARC verdicts.

tools.name: Google Admin Toolbox Messageheader
tools.description: Google Admin Toolbox alternative to Microsoft's analyzer: paste raw headers to visualize the email path, its delays and authentication results.

tools.name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
tools.description: Far more complete than basic IP tools for network forensics: BGP routes, announced prefixes, ASN history and peering for any IP, prefix or autonomous system.
